purpose: Positive fixture of a Web-written Session 51 with two Linear LOSATP drawings whose record instance keys collide (OV-3273, D-197): the copy of a drawing keeps its card uids, so after its region changes, one record instance key names other proteins in each drawing's protein identity manifest. Load then Save must keep each drawing's protein entries to those that resolve in its own manifest, which the CLI requires.
history: branch feat/ring-genome-files (#1777); Session 51 is not on main yet (docs/internal/SESSION_FORMAT_HISTORY.md)
route: A one-off Playwright route against the Web app of that commit (one worker): open the app, show the Linear drawing, give its two cards tests/test_inputs/BGC0000708.gbk and BGC0000709.gbk (app.setLinearSeqPrimaryFile), set the comparison to LOSAT, BLASTP, Similarity groups, serial execution, ribbon style, Generate; Duplicate drawing from the tab menu; in the copy, app.setLinearCardWindow(card 1, window 0, 'start', 1) and ('end', 20000), Generate; Save Session with the title 'BGC0000708-BGC0000709 two drawings'. The downloaded file was decompressed and written again with gzip -n -9.
values: drawings linear (BGC0000708 whole) and linear-2 (its copy, BGC0000708 1..20000), each with 4 protein LOSAT entries (one pair shown, three all-against-all searches with display false), one shared (both record instances of BGC0000709); ui.activeDrawingId linear-2. The record instance key of BGC0000708's card has runtime binding sha256:e3a4f6e98... in linear and sha256:0bd551043... in linear-2.
